create_madgrad_optimizer: create a MADGRAD optimizer instance with custom learning rate, momentum, and weight decay for a PyTorch model
create_madgrad_from_config: create a MADGRAD optimizer from a Config object and PyTorch model using the from_config class method
run_madgrad_step: run a single optimization step with the MADGRAD optimizer to update model parameters using dual averaged gradients
add_madgrad_param_group: add a new parameter group to the MADGRAD optimizer for fine-tuning frozen layers during training
reset_madgrad_param_groups: reset all parameter groups and internal state in the MADGRAD optimizer to start fresh
